model_system: AV3Sb5 kagome metals (illustrated with CsV3Sb5), focusing on van Hove singularities at the M points

key_params.ordering_wavevectors: three symmetry-related M points Q_i corresponding to 2x2 in-plane order
key_params.low_energy_basis: four van Hove singularities at M (two below and two above EF) with V dz2/dxz/dyz character and p-type/m-type sublattice polarization
key_params.ingredients: DFT electronic structure + symmetry classification of VHS Bloch states + coupled real-CDW/imagninary-CDW Landau free energy
key_params.soc: included at symmetry level; iCDW induces SDW at same wavevectors
key_params.mixed_states: 3Q-3Q and 2Q-1Q minima of the coupled Landau theory
key_params.material_example: CsV3Sb5 band structure used as representative

headline_claim: The coupled iCDW-rCDW Landau theory yields two generic mixed charge-ordered states in AV3Sb5—3Q-3Q and 2Q-1Q—and identifies seven symmetry-distinct iCDW orders; 2Q-1Q breaks C3 to produce an orthorhombic distortion, while 3Q-3Q can generate uniform ferro-, octupolar, toroidal, or monopolar magnetic order.
replication_difficulty: high - requires reconstructing DFT-derived VHS symmetry content and the paper’s custom group-theory/Landau analysis; no turnkey workflow is specified.
